name: Breitling SA
description: Swiss luxury watchmaker founded in 1884 in Saint-Imier, Switzerland. Specialised in precision chronographs. Known for aviation instruments, professional divers' watches, and the iconic Navitimer (1952) and Chronomat (1984). Headquartered in Grenchen, Switzerland.

founder.name: Léon Breitling
founder.description: Founded Breitling in Saint-Imier in 1884, specialising in precision chronographs for scientific and industrial use.

employee.name: Georges Kern
employee.description: Former head of IWC Schaffhausen (Richemont). Repositioned brand around casual luxury, Squads not Stars, and sustainability. Oversaw expansion from 50 to 300+ boutiques.

employee.name: Alfred Gantner
employee.description: Co-founder of Partners Group, majority shareholder since 2022.

ownershipStructure.2017: CVC Capital Partners — acquired from Schneider family
ownershipStructure.2022: Partners Group (>50% majority) — Alfred Gantner. CVC retains ~23%. Georges Kern + management team hold minority stake.

brandHistory.1884: Founded by Léon Breitling in Saint-Imier — precision chronographs
brandHistory.1952: Navitimer — official watch of AOPA pilots, circular slide rule
brandHistory.1962: Cosmonaute variant worn by Scott Carpenter on Mercury-Atlas 7
brandHistory.1979: Acquired by Ernest Schneider — saved from bankruptcy
brandHistory.1984: Chronomat — centenary watch, return of mechanical chronograph
brandHistory.2017: Georges Kern arrives, CVC acquisition, repositioning begins
brandHistory.2021: Carbon neutral operations — first major Swiss watch brand
brandHistory.2022: Partners Group majority. Acquisition of Universal Genève and Gallet.

sustainability.carbonNeutral: Since 2021 — first major Swiss watch brand to achieve this
sustainability.EcoVadis: Platinum medal — top 1% globally in CSR
sustainability.SBTi: Science Based Targets initiative — validated climate roadmap
sustainability.betterGold: Swiss Better Gold Association — artisanal mining
sustainability.Econyl: Recycled ocean nylon for strap ranges
